question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Stand in one’s own light

options.text: To act against one’s own interest

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4' **i.e. **'To act against one's own interest.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate** meaning of the idiom **"Stand in one's own light" is **"To act against one's own interest."**
 
• **"Stand in one's own light"** is an idiomatic expression that means to do something that hinders or undermines one's own success, progress, or opportunities.
 
• **"To act against one's own interest" **means to behave or make choices that are detrimental to oneself or go against one's own benefit or well-being.(अपने ही हित के खिलाफ कार्य करना) 

Therefore, the** correct answer** is: *'To act against one's own interest'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of the **other options:**

 
 
• **"In favor with"** refers to being in a position of favor or having positive relations with someone. 
 
• **"To disclose"** means to reveal or make something known.
 
• **"With all power"** refers to having full authority, control, or capability to do something.
